page.overview:
Who is Halandil Fang?

Halandil "Hal" Fang is an orc bard played by Liam O'Brien in Campaign Four.

Hal is an older orcish gentleman with white-streaked dark hair, who wears fine but not ostentatious clothing. He has smile lines around his eyes "from a life well-lived". Halandil is 6'2" tall. Nov 2025|12:24}}

Hal has tried to maintain a buoyant spirit throughout his life., where even as a 19-year-old he wore a smile most of the time although there was worry behind his eyes.}} Liam O'Brien described him as: "Hal is a successful entrepreneur of the arts, and family man, and scion of the city of Dol-Makjar. He's very much a man concerned with history and the future and finding the mortal identity in this godless world. Hal's real danger spot is his children. If someone really wanted to hurt Hal, it would be to go for his kids." His life has been full of family, friends, art, meaning and purpose, and a successful business. Nov 2025|05:52}}

Halandil grew up in the Rookery as the son of a foreign emissary and a soldier who separated when he was young. His mother, as an emissary, got him books from far away lands, so Hal grew up as a well-learned child. He was close to Thjazi Fang, his paternal younger half-brother, although they didn't see eye to eye all the time. Hal had to reprimand Thjazi from time to time, and Thjazi "gave him shit" when he was ten, but eventually the dynamic became more respectful. Later in life Thjazi started hiding dangerous aspects of his life from Hal to protect him..}}
